final_message: I parsed the log file workspace/worker.log by extracting entries with levels ERROR, SEVERE, or FATAL (case insensitive). I converted the timestamps to UTC in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. I extracted the service and the message (text after the last ' | ' on the first line of the entry). I calculated the repeat_count by adding 1 plus the sum of N from any '-- last message repeated N times --' lines following the entry. I aggregated counts_by_service as the sum of repeat_count per service. The results were written to workspace/errors.json following the specified JSON structure and Acme log-triage conventions. I also fixed the top-level key from "entries" to "errors" as required.
